verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              द्विजातयो व्रतोपेता यदिदं भुञ्जते हविः । अन्नं ब्राह्मणकामाय कथमेतत्पितामह ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhisthira said The three twice-born classes, who perform sacrifices and other rites, some times eat the remnants, consisting of meat and wine, of sacrifices in honour of the gods, from motives of obtaining children and heaven. What, O grandfather, is the nature of this act?

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              अवेदोक्तव्रतोपेता भुञ्जानाः कार्यकारिणः । वेदोक्तेषु च भुञ्जाना व्रतलुब्धा युधिष्ठिर ॥२॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Those who eat forbidden food without performing the sacrifices and vows ordained in the Vedas are known as wilful men. Those, on the other hand, who eat such food in the observance of Vedic sacrifices and vows and actuated by the desire of fruits in the shape of heaven and children, ascend to heaven but drop down on the termination of their merits.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              यदिदं तप इत्याहुरुपवासं पृथग्जनाः । एतत्तपो महाराज उताहो किं तपो भवेत् ॥३॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said Common people say that fasting is penance. Is fasting, however, really so, or is penance somethings different?

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              मासपक्षोपवासेन मन्यन्ते यत्तपो जनाः । आत्मतन्त्रोपघातस्तु न तपस्तत्सतां मतम् ॥४॥
verses.english: Bhishma said People really consider fast, measured by months or fortnights or days, as penance. The good, however, hold that such is not penance. On the other hand, fast is an obstacle to the acquirement of the knowledge of the Soul.

verses.sanskrit: त्यागश्च सन्नतिश्चैव शिष्यते तप उत्तमम् । सदोपवासी च भवेद्ब्रह्मचारी सदा भवेत् ॥५॥
verses.english: The renunciation of acts and humility form the highest penance. It is superior to all kinds of penance. He who performs such penance is considered as one who is always fasting and who is always leading a life of Brahmacharrya.

verses.sanskrit: मुनिश्च स्यात्सदा विप्रो दैवतं च सदा भवेत् । कुटुम्बिको धर्मकामः सदाऽस्वप्नश्च भारत ॥६॥
verses.english: Such a Brahman will become a Muni always, a deity, and sleepless forever, and one engaged in the pursuit of virtue only, even if he lives in a family.

verses.sanskrit: अमांसादी सदा च स्यात्पवित्रश्च सदा भवेत् । अमृताशी सदा च स्याद्देवतातिथिपूजकः ॥७॥
verses.english: He will become a vegetarian always, and pure for ever. He will become an eater always of ambrosia, and an worshipper always of gods and guests.

verses.sanskrit: विघसाशी सदा च स्यात्सदा चैवातिथिव्रतः । श्रद्दधानः सदा च स्याद्देवताद्विजपूजकः ॥८॥
verses.english: Indeed, he will be considered as one always living on sacrificial residue, as one ever devoted to the duty of hospitality, as one always full of faith, and as one always adoring gods and guests.

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              कधं सदोपवासी स्याद्ब्रह्मचारी कथं भवेत् । विघसाशी कथं च स्यात्सदा चैवातिथिव्रतः ॥९॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said one ever How can one practising such penance come to be known as one who is always fasting or as who follows the VOW of Brahmacharya, or as one who always lives upon sacrificial residue, or as one who always worships guests.

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              अन्तरा प्रातराशं च सायमाशं तथैव च । सदोपवासी स भवेद्यो न भुङ्क्तेऽन्तरा पुनः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Bhishma said He will be considered as one who is always fasting if he eats once during the day and once during the night at the fixed hours without eating anything in the interim.

verses.sanskrit: भार्यां गच्छन् ब्रह्मचारी ऋतौ भवति वै द्विजः । ऋतुवादी भवेन्नित्यं ज्ञाननित्यश्च यो नरः ॥११॥
verses.english: Such a Brahman, by always speaking the truth and by following always wisdom, and by going to his wife only in her season and never at other times, becomes a Brahmacharin.

verses.sanskrit: न भक्षयेत्तथा मांसमपांसाशी भवत्यपि । दाननित्यः पवित्रश्च अस्वप्नश्च दिवाऽस्वपन् ॥१२॥
verses.english: By never cating meat of animals not killed for sacrifice, he will become a strict vegetarian. By always becoming charitable he will become ever pure, and by abstaining from sleep during De day he will become one who is always awake.

verses.sanskrit: भृत्यातिथिषु यो भुङ्क्ते भुक्तवत्सु सदा सदा । अमृतं केवलं भुङ्क्ते इति विद्धि युधिष्ठिर ॥१३॥
verses.english: Know, O Yudhisthira, that the man who eats only after having fed his servants and guests becomes an eater always of ambrosia.

verses.sanskrit: अभुक्तवत्सु नाश्नानः सततं यस्तु वै द्विजः । अभोजनेन तेनास्य जितः स्वर्गो भवत्युत ॥१४॥
verses.english: The Brahmana who never eats till gods and guests are fed, acquires by such abstention, heaven itself.

verses.sanskrit: देवताभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च भृत्येभ्योऽतिथिभिः सह । अवशिष्टं तु योऽश्नाति तमाहुर्विघसाशिनम् ॥१५॥
verses.english: He is said to live upon sacrificial residue who eats only what remains after feeding the gods, the Pitris, servants and guests.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां लोका ह्यपर्यन्ताः सदने ब्रह्मणा सह । उपस्थिताश्चाप्सरोभिः परियान्ति दिवौकसः ॥१६॥
verses.english: Such men acquires numberless blessed regions in next life. The gods and the Apsaras with Brahman himself, come to their homes.

verses.sanskrit: देवताभिश्च ये सार्धं पितृभिश्चोपभुञ्जते । रमन्ते पुत्रपौत्रैश्च तेषां गतिरनुत्तमा ॥१७॥
verses.english: They who share their food with the gods and the Pitris pass their days always happily with their sons and grandsons, and at last, leaving off this body, acquire a very high end.
